gameDescriptionHtml:
Every Second Counts. History Is Inevitable.

April 14, 1912. The final night of the RMS Titanic.

You are a private investigator aboard the world’s most famous ocean liner. What begins as a routine voyage soon becomes something far darker: a suspicious death, hidden clues, locked rooms, restricted decks, and a mystery buried deep within the ship.

Explore the Titanic before disaster strikes. Question passengers, search cabins, uncover secrets, and follow a trail that leads from the elegance of First Class to the shadowed lower decks below. But as the truth begins to surface, so does the danger.

And then the iceberg hits.

What was once an investigation becomes a desperate fight for survival as freezing water floods the ship, corridors tilt, lights fail, and panic spreads across the decks. Every choice matters. Every second counts.

The ship will sink.

What you discover — and who you save — is up to you.

KEY FEATURES:

Explore the Titanic Before and During the Disaster
Walk through richly detailed areas of the ship, from luxurious public rooms to restricted service corridors, cargo spaces, machinery areas, and lifeboat decks.

Investigate a Dark Mystery
Search crime scenes, collect evidence, question passengers, and uncover hidden connections before the final night arrives.

Puzzle and Lock Interaction
Solve environmental puzzles, open locked doors, decode clues, and use tools to access restricted areas.

Stealth and Tension
Enter forbidden sections of the ship, avoid dangerous enemies, and uncover secrets others want buried.

Dynamic Sinking Gameplay
Experience rising water, tilting decks, blocked paths, failing lights, and changing environments as Titanic succumbs to the Atlantic.

Survival Mechanics
Manage cold, stamina, blocked routes, and physical hazards while trying to reach safety.

Moral Choices and Multiple Endings
In the final moments, decide what matters most: justice, love, or saving as many lives as possible.

Historical Atmosphere
Meet passengers and crew inspired by real Titanic history, and witness moments of human courage, fear, and sacrifice during the final hours.

Do you have what it takes to survive the most famous shipwreck in history? Or will you become another soul claimed by the icy depths? The clock is ticking. The water is rising. Your decisions will determine your fate.
